text:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up — we’re opening the EU on-prem preview next week for customers who need VPC/private control with local data residency. Targeting 2026-04-01 for first invites.

Dan Rivera: Awesome. Does this include the KMS/HSM integration we demoed last quarter?

Elena Park: Yes — initial preview will support AWS CloudHSM and Azure Key Vault HSM-backed keys. We’ll ship an HSM integration guide in the docs.

Maria Gomez: Security note — please attach the SOC2 evidence packet and the GDPR checklist for the preview. SEs will need them when talking to regulated customers.

Priyanka Shah: Working on that now. I’ll drop a Gov/Compliance checklist and a sample DPA redline by EOD Friday. @legal-bot can you signal if anything sensitive pops up?

Legal Bot: Noted. I’ll surface contract clauses that need executive sign-off. Expect DPA template and export controls doc by 2026-03-28.

Sam Li: Ops question — what’s the upgrade window for Private installs? Customers ask about disruption.

Elena Park: We’ll support a rolling 30-min maintenance window with zero-downtime fallback to hosted for the preview. Full HA guide is in the private-preview docs.

Dan Rivera: For sales/SEs: please use the private preview signup form (internal only) and mark high-risk/regulatory customers with the tag "eu-onprem-preview". I’ll coordinate invites.

Maria Gomez: Can we post a short install snippet for SEs? makes lead qualification faster.

Elena Park: Yep — put this in the docs and the SE playbook. Example CLI for on-prem bootstrap: 

```
# bootstrap a private node with KMS
rdictl bootstrap --mode private --region eu-west-1 \
  --kms-provider aws-cloudhsm \
  --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```

Priyanka Shah: Also adding a quick-runbook for incident response when HSM connectivity fails — includes failover to cached keys and telemetry signals.

Sam Li: Heads-up to Eng-Infra — we’ll need images tagged "private-eu-preview" and a slim ops repo with the HSM connector. @SRE Bot can you create a ticket?

SRE Bot: Ticket created: #INFR-1289 — "Private EU preview images & HSM connector". Assignee: eng-infra. ETA: 2026-03-30.

Dan Rivera: One more — CS/Success: prioritize these customers for a joint kickoff webinar early April. I’ll draft the invite.

Elena Park: Thanks everyone. Action items: Priyanka (DPA + runbook), Maria (SOC2/GDPR artifacts), Sam (images + ops repo), Dan (invite cadence). I’ll publish the internal preview FAQ tomorrow and send the invite list by Friday. :party-popper:
